chunks: 4442 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who freed a female slave belonging to him and made her emancipation her dowry, then divorced her before consummating the marriage.
He عليه السلام said: "Her emancipation has taken effect, and her master reclaims from her half of her price-value, which she must strive to pay. There is no waiting period ('iddah) for him over her."

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: he emancipated or freed from bondage
key_terms.تَسْعَى: she works or strives to pay it off
key_terms.صَدَاقَهَا: her dowry in the marriage contract
key_terms.مَمْلُوكَةً: a female slave owned by him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man frees his female slave as her dowry and then divorces her before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a man who frees his female slave and makes that emancipation her dowry, then divorces her before consummation. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the emancipation remains valid, half of her value is to be recovered, and no 'iddah is due upon her in relation to him.
